instruction: Please help me install the extension Jupyter in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Jupyter extension in VS Code. The evaluator checks if the extension ID 'ms-toolsai.jupyter' is present in the output of 'code --list-extensions'. The existing metric 'is_extension_installed' is used with type='contain' to verify the extension is installed.

llm_judge_reasons: Command uses shell pipe operator '|' in array format without shell=true
The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'ms-toolsai.jupyter'] will treat '|' as a literal argument, not a pipe operator
This will cause the command to fail at runtime - the pipe requires shell=true or the command must be a single string
The evaluator logic is semantically correct (checking for extension installation), but will fail due to incorrect command execution format
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add '"shell": true' to the result config at evaluator.result.shell
OR change command from array to single string: '"command": "code --list-extensions | grep ms-toolsai.jupyter"'
Recommended: Use single string format with shell=true for clarity: {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep ms-toolsai.jupyter", "shell": true}
